verdict.rationale: Unstructured's pricing page offers deployment in your own dedicated instance or VPC with full data isolation, and the docs include a dedicated-instances security model covering controls such as IP allowlisting. That covers the core need to keep documents inside your own infrastructure, though it is an enterprise, sales-tailored offering. Missing for 10: technical deployment docs for the VPC install, evidence of a fully self-hosted or on-prem/air-gapped option, independent or hands-on corroboration.
